## Summary

**Consolidate repeated Run context and accounting**

Full identity/accounting tables repeat on every dashboard and push primary evidence down.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P1**
- Wave: **V2**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P1-05`
- DUX code: `DUX5-14`

## Scope

Overview, Pipeline, Provider, DQ, Trust; Run Explorer remains detailed owner.

Screenshot groups: SG-03..SG-07 lower-page Run context; SG-01 remains owner

## Concrete change

Show a compact identity/accounting strip and link to Run Explorer. Keep detailed forensic tables only in the explorer.

## Expected effect

Less scrolling and higher first-screen signal density.

## Acceptance criteria

- Non-explorer dashboards show ≤1 compact row; full details remain reachable in one click.
- Aligns with epic acceptance: Status/Reason/Impact/Action visible without internal scroll on first viewport
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic introduced only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Stable Run Explorer URL parameters.

## Risk

Users accustomed to inline detail may need transition guidance.

## Overlap / predecessor notes

Enforces DUX4-23: compact identity strip; Run Explorer owns forensic detail.

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON only; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Run Explorer remains forensic owner when moving detail off domain boards
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; keep first-screen copy to 2-4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots for affected panels (dark theme)
- [ ] Viewports: 1366x768, 1440x900, 1920x1080 at 100% (125% when layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest for navigation/contracts if JSON structure changes
- [ ] Manual operator 5-second comprehension check on first-screen card
